scams.name: Malaga Airport (AGP) & Late-Night Taxi Overcharge
scams.description: Málaga–Costa del Sol Airport (AGP) is one of Spain's busiest, serving the entire Costa del Sol package-tourism belt from Torremolinos to Marbella. The legitimate licensed taxi fare from AGP to central Malaga is €20–€28 on the meter; to Torremolinos €20–€30; to Marbella €60–€90. Overnight and weekend surcharges can add 20–30% per the official tariff. r/GoingToSpain 'Late-night arrival at Málaga Airport — taxi costs + Marbella' (comments/1r83qwu, 2025) is the canonical 2025 anchor: 'Your only option after midnight is taxi. Probably €50 till €80. Price uber and bolt and local white' — meaning after midnight, supply is constrained and overcharge pressure spikes. r/MalagaTourism 'Transportation in Malaga' (comments/1r88v9f, 2025) captures the 2025 visitor concern: 'I'd like to know though whether I should be cautious about taxi scams from the airport to the city c' entre. The community's answer: yes, particularly for late-night arrivals. The Renfe Cercanías C1 train from AGP to Malaga-María Zambrano station runs every 20 minutes for €2.05 (30-minute journey) — the cheapest and overcharge-proof option when available (5 AM to midnight). r/GoingToSpain 'Beware of this taxi scam' (comments/1mk8n4c, 2025) documents the blurry-meter pattern that operates at AGP as well. For older travelers, the practical defence: (1) use Renfe Cercanías C1 train if arriving between 5 AM and midnight (€2.05, 30 min to Malaga centre); (2) Uber, Bolt, and FreeNow operate at AGP with app-regulated fares; (3) if taking a licensed taxi, insist on the meter and confirm the €20–€28 range to central Malaga; (4) for Marbella transfers after midnight, budget €80 but insist on the meter; (5) avoid any driver approaching inside the terminal rather than waiting at the rank.
scams.avoidance: Use Renfe Cercanías C1 train: €2.05, every 20 min, 30 min to Malaga centre (runs 5 AM–midnight) Uber, Bolt, and FreeNow operate at AGP with app-regulated fares Insist on the meter; confirm €20–€28 range to Malaga centre before boarding For Marbella after midnight, budget €80 but insist on the meter Photograph the taxi plate number from the rear windscreen on entering
scams.location: Málaga–Costa del Sol Airport (AGP) taxi rank, late-night arrivals to Marbella/Torremolinos, return rides from Costa del Sol resorts

scams.name: AVIS, Budget, and Budget-Aggregator Rental Car Scams
scams.description: Malaga's rental-car economy is massive — the Costa del Sol is one of Europe's top drive-holiday destinations. This concentration has produced one of Spain's most documented rental-scam ecosystems, with multiple named-anchor 2025 community complaints. r/GoingToSpain 'AVIS BUDGET SCAMS IN MALAGA' (comments/1jit8wl, 2025) is the capital-letters 2025 anchor documenting a family's AVIS/Budget scam at AGP: 'We (my family and including some of my' relatives were hit with multiple surprise charges including fabricated damage and insurance upsells they declined at the counter. r/Malaga 'Car rental at airport' (comments/1fd3h9v, 2024) gives the two-year-dispute context: 'Scam company and make up damages plus Addon. Took two years to get my money back and I had proof wit' h photos and video of the pickup condition. r/GoingToSpain 'Beware of latest rental car scam in Spain' (comments/1ei4kan, 2025) specifically flags Malaga operators in the broader Spanish pattern. r/spain 'Doyouspain and Okmobility …the rental car scam made in Spain' (comments/1dd8x7w, 2025) is a cross-Spain warning about two specific aggregators that operate heavily at AGP: 'This company is a scam, preying on customers with unfair charges and then refusing to provide any su' pport when disputes arise. The scam genres: (1) pre-existing damage attributed post-return; (2) mandatory collision-damage-waiver upsells at 2–3x online rates; (3) fuel-policy overcharging; (4) 'cleaning fee' after normal use. For older travelers on a Costa del Sol holiday, the protective playbook: (1) avoid Goldcar, Centauro, OK Mobility, Doyouspain, and budget AVIS/Budget at AGP — community-flagged repeat offenders; (2) book direct with Hertz, Europcar, or local Cicar for better reliability (still requires walk-around discipline); (3) at pickup, video a walk-around narrating visible marks; (4) photograph all four sides, roof, wheels, and undercarriage via phone camera through the wheel well; (5) decline collision-damage-waiver upsells if your credit card provides car-rental insurance; (6) on return, video the vehicle and retain the fuel receipt; (7) dispute any post-return damage claim with your credit card within 48 hours using your photo/video evidence.
scams.avoidance: Avoid community-flagged operators at AGP: Goldcar, Centauro, OK Mobility, Doyouspain, budget AVIS/Budget Book direct with Hertz, Europcar, or Cicar for better reliability Video walk-around narrating visible marks at pickup before signing any paperwork Photograph all four sides, roof, wheels, and undercarriage via phone camera through wheel well Decline CDW upsells if your credit card provides car-rental insurance (Visa/MC/Amex premium typically do)
scams.location: AGP airport rental desks (AVIS, Budget, Goldcar, Centauro, OK Mobility), Malaga city-centre rental offices, post-return damage claims

scams.name: Malaga Old Town Pickpockets & Tout-Driven Nightclubs
scams.description: Malaga's old town has a moderate pickpocket problem concentrated in tourist zones. r/Malaga 'Is there alot of crime or pickpocketing in Malaga?' (comments/13k1pin) gives the local-resident view: 'I've lived in Málaga now for three months and it's usually the northern African french speaking peop' le who operate at Calle Larios and Plaza de la Merced crowds. r/askspain 'Where are pickpocketing and scams commonly occur in' (comments/wwj887) places Malaga on the moderate tier of the Spanish scale — worse than Bilbao, comparable to Valencia. The nightlife-specific variant: tout-driven bars where promoters stand outside, grab passing tourists (or their arms), and funnel them into venues with inflated drink prices. r/Malaga 'People outside Bars/Nightclubs' (comments/zwvpos) documents the 2024 pattern: 'It is not a scam, they get money for bringing people to clubs that are not in the main streets. The' — but inflated drink prices once inside and aggressive pressure to order specific 'packages' turn the 'legal' commission into a scam experience. r/Europetravel 'Theft in Spain? Should I be worried?' (comments/1ewihbm, 2025) gives the broader context. For older travelers, the practical defence: (1) crossbody bag in front on Calle Larios and at Malaga Cathedral/Alcazaba entrance queues; (2) phone in zipped inner pocket, never back pocket or outer backpack; (3) avoid tout-driven bars off Plaza de la Merced — r/Malaga community recommends walking directly to named venues rather than accepting street-commission referrals; (4) for genuine Malaga tapas, walk to Pimpi (Calle Granada — famous but honest), Casa Aranda (Calle Herrería del Rey — churros y chocolate), or Uvedoble Taberna (Calle Císter — creative Andalusian); (5) file denuncia at Policía Nacional Malaga (Plaza Manuel Azaña, +34 951 939 000) within 48 hours for insurance.
scams.avoidance: Wear zipped crossbody bag in front on Calle Larios, Plaza de la Merced, and at Alcazaba queue Avoid tout-driven bars off Plaza de la Merced — walk directly to named venues Community-recommended tapas: Pimpi (Calle Granada), Casa Aranda (churros), Uvedoble Taberna (Calle Císter) Phone in zipped inner pocket, never back pocket or outer backpack File denuncia at Policía Nacional Malaga (+34 951 939 000) within 48 hours for insurance
scams.location: Calle Larios shopping strip, Plaza de la Merced, Malaga Cathedral area, Alcazaba entrance queue, Pedregalejo nightlife, tout-driven bars off the main street

scams.name: Costa del Sol Beach Theft at Malagueta & Torremolinos
scams.description: Costa del Sol beaches follow the Spain-wide pattern of opportunistic phone and wallet theft during swim windows. r/GoingToSpain 'What do you do with your phone/wallet if spending time at' (comments/1efvwql, 2025) offers the 2025 community advice: 'Don't bring them to the beach. go to a non-crowded beach, (very lesser chance of your stuff being st' olen. r/Europetravel 'Theft in Spain? Should I be worried?' (comments/1ewihbm, 2025) flags Costa del Sol specifically: 'Most of the theft in the big cities involves bags left at beaches, or cell phones walking down the street. Just try to m' inimise what you bring. The Malagueta and Torremolinos variant is similar to Valencia's Malvarrosa: opportunistic crews rather than organised 'scarf-seller' follow-up, but still persistent. r/AskBarcelona 'Can I leave my stuff unattended while swimming?' (comments/1mv3ncb, 2025) gives the broader 2025 community rule: 'Of course there could be a thief waiting around on the beach, hoping' — meaning the expected outcome of leaving belongings unattended is theft. For older travelers on a Malaga cruise day or Costa del Sol beach visit, the practical defence: (1) rent a beachfront locker at chiringuito (€3–€5 per session) for valuables; (2) use a waterproof pouch around your neck for phone and one card only during swims; (3) if you must leave items on a towel, keep them physically under your body during short dips; (4) for cruise passengers, leave wallet and passport in the cabin safe rather than bringing to the beach; (5) avoid beaches at dusk or empty-hours when observation drops; (6) file denuncia at Policía Nacional Malaga (+34 951 939 000) within 48 hours for insurance.
scams.avoidance: Rent beachfront locker at chiringuito (€3–€5 per session) for valuables during swims Use waterproof pouch around your neck for phone and one card only during swims If leaving items on a towel, keep them physically under your body during short dips For cruise passengers, leave wallet and passport in cabin safe rather than bringing to beach File denuncia at Policía Nacional Malaga (+34 951 939 000) within 48 hours for insurance
scams.location: Playa de la Malagueta (central Malaga beach), Torremolinos La Carihuela, Benalmádena beachfront chiringuitos, cruise-day beach visits from Malaga Port

scams.name: Fake Alcazaba, Gibralfaro & Picasso Museum Ticket Resellers
scams.description: Malaga's attraction-ticket ecosystem is smaller than Granada's or Seville's, but clone-site and reseller scams still operate. r/GoingToSpain 'Tickets for Alcazaba and Gibralfaro in Malaga' (comments/1jbd2ru, 2025) is the named 2025 community question: 'Where can I buy tickets in advance for Alcazaba and Gibralfaro in Málaga? What I think is an officia' l site turns out to be a reseller at inflated prices. r/Malaga 'Planning a trip to Malaga soon for 3 days' (comments/vayaf4) gives the practical local advice: 'If you go around Sunday, the Alcazaba is free all day and the Picasso museum is free for the last tw' o hours — free-entry windows exist and are exactly what reseller sites obscure. r/GoingToSpain 'Should we buy tickets in advance for following locations?' (comments/1slhwl4, 2025) documents the community's 2025 rule: the Alcazaba rarely requires advance purchase since queues are short; Gibralfaro has similar walk-up availability; and the Picasso Museum's official site (museopicassomalaga.org) should be the only booking source. Legitimate prices: Alcazaba €3.50 (free Sundays after 2 PM), Alcazaba + Gibralfaro combo €5.50, Picasso Museum €9.50. Any reseller charging €15–€25 for these tickets is marking up or operating as an outright scam. For older travelers on a cruise day or overnight Malaga visit, the defensive rule: (1) book Alcazaba and Gibralfaro combo (€5.50) at malagaturismo.com or at the physical entrance; (2) book Picasso Museum directly at museopicassomalaga.org (€9.50 adult); (3) take advantage of Sunday afternoon free entry at Alcazaba and last-two-hours free entry at Picasso Museum; (4) skip Google ads and reseller packages; (5) licensed third-party resellers with buyer protection are GetYourGuide and Tiqets only.
scams.avoidance: Book Alcazaba/Gibralfaro at malagaturismo.com or physical entrance (€3.50, combo €5.50) Book Picasso Museum at museopicassomalaga.org (€9.50 adult) Take free-entry windows: Alcazaba Sunday afternoons, Picasso Museum last two hours of the day Use only GetYourGuide or Tiqets for licensed third-party reseller bookings Skip tout offers near Cathedral or Roman Theatre — walk to the physical entrance
scams.location: Online — third-party resellers for Alcazaba, Castillo de Gibralfaro, Picasso Museum; tout stalls near the Cathedral and Roman Theatre

scams.name: Malaga Airbnb ID-Theft & Off-Platform Rental Fraud
scams.description: Malaga's short-term rental economy has generated a distinct ID-theft variant of the Spain-wide Airbnb fraud pattern. r/Malaga 'AirBnB scam? Asking for my ID' (comments/1816csz) documents the canonical local warning: 'hosts' request high-resolution scans of the guest's passport and credit card via non-platform messaging (WhatsApp, email), then use the documents for identity fraud or to create fake listings of their own. r/GoingToSpain 'Spain and the scammers at all levels' (comments/1dzs1fn, 2025) frames the 2025 broader ecosystem: 'Somehow scammers get your electrical supply data and bank data to try and scam you over the phone if you live in Spain' — ID harvesting in one channel feeds scams in another. r/Malaga 'Hello! I need help. How can I pay this?' (comments/1sfsjiw, 2025) documents the 2025 post-scam confusion where victims receive mystery bills after ID data has been compromised. r/travel 'A rant about Airbnb rants' (comments/1e8t94o) gives the broader platform-fraud context that applies equally in Malaga. r/GoingToSpain 'Why am I seeing a lot of SCAM!! posts related to housing/' (comments/1ed4g94, 2024) places Malaga alongside Barcelona, Valencia, and Donostia as tourism-driven fraud hotspots. For older travelers considering Malaga accommodation longer than a weekend, the protective playbook: (1) book only through Airbnb or Booking.com with platform-verified payment and cancellation protection; (2) refuse off-platform ID-scan requests — legitimate hosts use the Airbnb platform's ID verification; (3) if a host insists on a non-platform ID scan, report the host to Airbnb immediately; (4) for Idealista or other listings, demand a video call with the apartment visible before any deposit; (5) refuse Bizum, Western Union, or cryptocurrency payment for any accommodation deposit; (6) if ID is compromised, notify your credit card company and Spanish Policía Nacional Malaga (+34 951 939 000) immediately.
scams.avoidance: Book only through Airbnb or Booking.com with platform-verified payment Refuse off-platform ID-scan requests; legitimate hosts use the Airbnb platform verification If a host insists on non-platform ID, report them to Airbnb immediately Refuse Bizum, Western Union, or cryptocurrency payment for any accommodation deposit If ID compromised, notify credit card company + Policía Nacional Malaga (+34 951 939 000)
scams.location: Malaga city-centre Airbnb listings, Costa del Sol short-term rental platforms, private off-platform referrals during peak summer and Easter
